moments.title: European Athletics Championships begin in Birmingham
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham, bringing Europe's elite track and field athletes to the UK for a week of competition.

angles.name: Main Event Kick-off
angles.copy: Europe's best are in Birmingham! The European Athletics Championships are officially underway, bringing a week of incredible track and field action. Who are you backing for gold?

angles.name: Birmingham Buzz
angles.copy: The Alexander Stadium is buzzing! Birmingham is hosting the European Athletics Championships, a huge moment for UK sport. Get ready for some unforgettable performances.

angles.name: Team GB Hopes
angles.copy: It's showtime! The European Athletics Championships start today. All eyes on Team GB to see if they can bring home a haul of medals on home soil.

moments.title: Community Shield heads to Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff, get ready for the season curtain-raiser! The Community Shield between Arsenal and Man City is coming to Principality Stadium this Sunday. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Premier League Warm-up
angles.copy: The Community Shield is just a week away! Arsenal vs Manchester City this Sunday in Cardiff. A first glimpse of the Premier League giants before the season kicks off.

angles.name: Welsh Capital Football
angles.copy: Big game coming to the capital! Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this Sunday. Two of England's biggest clubs battling it out right here in Wales.

moments.title: EFL Championship season kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season begins on the weekend of August 14-16, with Wolves hosting Blackburn Rovers in the opening match on Friday 14 August.

angles.name: Championship is Back
angles.copy: Football is back! The EFL Championship season kicks off next weekend. Who's your pick for promotion this year?

angles.name: Welsh Teams in Action
angles.copy: The Championship season starts next week! Swansea and Cardiff are back in action. How do you think our Welsh clubs will fare this season?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The EFL Championship season starts Friday, August 14th. Get ready for a packed weekend of football.

moments.title: Premier League pre-season games continue
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are continuing their pre-season preparations with fixtures today, including Arsenal hosting Borussia Dortmund.

angles.name: Pre-season Action

angles.name: Arsenal's Build-up

moments.title: A-Level Results Day approaches
moments.blurb: Students across England, Northern Ireland, and Wales will receive their A-Level results on Thursday, August 13, 2026.

angles.name: Results Day Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on! A-Level Results Day is this Thursday. Wishing all students the very best of luck with their grades and future plans!

angles.name: Next Steps
angles.copy: A-Level Results Day is almost here! Whether it's uni, an apprenticeship, or a gap year, remember there are so many paths to success. Good luck to everyone receiving grades this week.

angles.name: Welsh Students Prepare
angles.copy: Good luck to all Welsh students awaiting their A-Level results this Thursday! The big day is almost here.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK Singles Chart #1
